environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed with Quarkus native image, exposed via Lambda Function URL with AuthType=NONE. The function URL endpoint is publicly accessible at https://<url-id>.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/. No API Gateway, no WAF, no additional authentication layer. The function connects to an RDS PostgreSQL instance in the same VPC. Any HTTP client can POST GraphQL queries directly to the function URL.

config.network: Lambda in VPC with RDS access
